name: Xbox
description: The settings given to xemu before every Xbox game starts.

surfaceScale.label: Render resolution
surfaceScale.description: The size xemu draws at, as a multiple of the console's 640×480. “Follow the stream” draws at the resolution chosen for the game: ×1 up to 720p, ×2 for 1080p.

filtering.label: Picture filtering
filtering.description: How the picture is resized to the screen: smooth, or sharp pixels.

aspectRatio.label: Aspect ratio
aspectRatio.description: Auto follows what the game asks for; 16:9 fills a wide screen.

vsync.label: Vertical sync
vsync.description: Off shows each frame as soon as it is ready: less latency, possible tearing.

cacheShaders.label: Keep compiled shaders
cacheShaders.description: Shaders compiled once are kept for the next game, which then stutters less.

hardFpu.label: Fast floating point
hardFpu.description: Floating-point maths runs on the processor directly. Off is slower and more exact, for the rare game that needs it.

dsp.label: Audio DSP
dsp.description: Emulates the Xbox's audio processor, which a few games use for effects. Costs processor time.

hrtf.label: 3D audio (HRTF)
hrtf.description: Positions sounds in space for headphones. Off saves processor time.
